description: Put 2 to 10 estate sales in driving order for one day, from an optional starting point, with each stop's hours that day and a Google Maps link for the whole trip. Order is by straight-line distance. Sales whose street address is not posted yet, or that are not open that day, are left off and listed separately.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the day most of the chosen sales are open.

start_city.description: Where the trip starts, e.g. "Richardson". Or use start_latitude and start_longitude.

name: plan_estate_sale_route
title: Plan an estate sale route
